Points:\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EI learned the difference between Cardiac asthama and Bronchial asthama.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EI learned the role of corticosteroids in treatment of Bronchial Asthama.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EI learned why the corticosteroids are given in Inhalation route.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EI learned the signs and symptoms of Bronchial asthama\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EI learned importance of developing raport with patient that helps in eliciating detailed history.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EOSCE:\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ETypes of abnormal breath sounds:\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E1 .Wheezing - High pitched soundeds produced by narrowed airways\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E2.Stridor - Wheeze like sound heard when a person breaths\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E3. Rales- Small Clicking, bubbling ,or rattling sounds in the lungs .They are heard when a person breathes in Inhales.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E4.Rhonchi - Sounds that resembles snoring\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EQ.Sequence of events :\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EWhat was your patient's hourly workflow before the illness and how did it change after?\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EA:\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EBefore the Illness:\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E1. Morning Routine:\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp;- Woke up at 6 AM and engaged in household activities, including dishwashing and cooking breakfast.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp;- Breakfast comprised rice and curry, followed by cleaning the house and socializing with neighbors.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E2. Daytime Activities:\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp;- Lunch around 2 PM, followed by cleaning and preparing food for son and daughter-in-law upon their return from work.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp;- Quality family time in the evening, dinner at 8 PM, and sound sleep by 9 or 10 PM.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E3. Sleep Quality:\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp;- Enjoyed a restful sleep, waking up refreshed in the morning.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EAfter the Illness:\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E1. Altered Wake-up Time:\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp;- Wakes up 2 hours later at 8 AM and struggles with reduced energy levels.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E2. Limited Physical Activity:\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp;- Inability to perform household chores due to exertion, struggles with standing for prolonged periods.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp;- Reduced food intake, with difficulty in managing daily tasks and taking care of family.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E3. Progressive Decline:\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp;- Gradual deterioration, leading to dependence on assistance for basic activities, including using the washroom.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp;- Nighttime disturbances, waking up multiple times due to cough, resulting in morning sluggishness\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E4. Impact on Sleep Quality:\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp;- Sleep quality deteriorated post-illness, marked by disruptions during the night and a less refreshed feeling upon waking up.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cbr following E-log aims at discussing our patient de-identified health data shared after taking the guardian's signed consent.\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EHere we discuss our individual patient problems through series of inputs from available global online community of experts with an aim to solve the patients clinical problem with current best evidence based input.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cdiv class=\"separator\" style=\"clear: both; text-align: center;\"\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EThis E-log also reflects my patient's centered online learning portfolio.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EI have been given this case to solve in an attempt to understand the topic of \"Patient Clinical Data Analysis\" to develop my competency in reading and comprehending clinical data including history, clinical findings, investigations and come up with a diagnosis and providing treatment best to our skills and wisdom. \u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EThis the case of 75 years old female housewife , resident of miryalaguda\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u0026nbsp;\u0026nbsp;CHEIF COMPLAINTS:\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EShortness of Breath Since 10days\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EDry Cough Occasionally.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EHISTORY OF PRESENTING ILLNESS: Patient was apparentley asymptomatic 10 days ago then she developed a shortness of breath which is insidious in onset,MMRC Grade 2 not associated with Wheeze.Aggrevated on exposure to cold and dust.Orthopnea(+). \u0026nbsp;No paroxysmal nocturnal dyspnea. Patient also has a chief complaints of dry cough since 1week occasionally . \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; No history of fever\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ENo history of chest pain\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ENo history of chest tightness\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ENo history of heamoptysis,swelling \u0026amp;palpitations.\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ENo chief complaints of loss of weight \u0026amp; loss of appetite .\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EHISTORY OF PAST ILLNESS :\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EHistory of similar complaints since 10years \u0026nbsp; on rotex inhaler (FLUTICAZONE \u0026amp;VILANTROL).\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EPatient on tablet ACEBROPHYLLIN 100mg \/po\/bd\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EKnown case of Asthama since 10yrs\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EKnown case of Diabetes since 5 days.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EN\/k\/c\/o Tuberculosis ,Hypertension ,Epilepsy ,thyroid disorders .\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ETREATMENT HISTORY :\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EDiabetes \u0026nbsp;since 5 days but not on medication.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EAsthama on inhaler usage.\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EPERSONAL HISTORY :\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EMarried , appetite normal\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003Emixed diet,\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003Ebowel \u0026amp; bladder movements are regular .\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ENo known allergies\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ENo addictions.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EFAMILY HISTORY:\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ENo significant.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EMENSTRUAL HISTORY:\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EAge of menarch: 14 years\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EAge of menopause: 49 years\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EGENERAL EXAMINATION:\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ENo pallor ,icterus clubbing ,cyanosis ,lymphadenopathy\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EThere is Bilateral pitting edema up to ankle.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ETemperature: afebrile, Pulse:110bpm \u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ERespiratory rate: 25cpm\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EBP: \u0026nbsp;140\/80mmofhg, Spo2: 96% GRBS :358mg%\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ESYSTEMIC EXAMINATION:\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ECardiovascular system: S1S2 heard, no thrills ,no murmurs.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ERespiratory system:\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EInspection:\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EShape of chest:Barrel shaped\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ETeachea is central\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EBilateral symmetrical chest expansion observed\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EBilateral course crests,diffuse (+)\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ENo visible pulsations \/sinuses\/scars seen .\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EPalpation : (Confirming findings on
